svg.text: Ramp hook: the final design, to scale
All views at one scale (scale bars below). FLOWER from the Competition Manual, Fig 9-12; "est." marks a size scaled off the figure, not dimensioned. Robot sizes are this design's.
1 · From the side, cut through the middle (the robot drives right, into the FLOWER)
2 · From above, seated in a FLOWER
From above: the front follows the bottom ring's hole
Retrieval opening, tiles to the lower bracket
Ring's front edge to the uprights
Clear space, intake to the block
Block: front to back × tall, bottom up
Stowed (wall in front of the chassis)
Model: 4 POLLEN out, driven to the uprights
Why the side wall and curtains are 3.5 in tall:
the curtains pass under the FLOWER's bracket (3.55 in), and stowed the hook fits the 18 in start.
A falling POLLEN's first bounce is about 13 in high, so no wall stops it. Walls catch the rolling
and low-hopping ones, which needs a wall taller than a POLLEN's middle (1.4 in).
